ceo.name: Lip-Bu Tan
ceo.background: Former CEO of Cadence Design Systems (2009-2021), where he more than doubled revenues, expanded operating margins and delivered stock price appreciation of >3,200%. Appointed Intel CEO March 2025.
ceo.track_record: Transformed Cadence into global leader with exceptional financial performance. Fresh appointment to Intel with turnaround mandate following Pat Gelsinger's retirement in December 2024.

cfo.name: David Zinsner
cfo.background: MBA from Vanderbilt University, Bachelor's from Carnegie Mellon. Previously CFO at Micron Technology (2018-2022) and Analog Devices (2009-2018). Appointed Intel CFO January 2022.

key_executives.name: Frank D. Yeary
key_executives.tenure: Board member since 2009, Chair since January 2023

key_executives.name: Kevork Kechichian
key_executives.background: 30+ years at Arm, most recently EVP Engineering. Joined Intel 2025.

key_executives.name: Annie Shea Weckesser
key_executives.position: SVP & Chief Marketing and Communications Officer
key_executives.background: Appointed 2025 to lead integrated global marketing and communications.

key_executives.name: Robin Colwell
key_executives.background: Joined Intel 2025 to lead global policy and regulatory engagement.

recent_changes: Pat Gelsinger retired as CEO December 2024 after 3.8-year tenure
Lip-Bu Tan appointed CEO March 2025 with $69M compensation package
Michelle Johnston Holthaus departed after 30+ years, remains advisory through March 2026
Major leadership appointments in 2025: Kechichian (DCG), Weckesser (CMCO), Colwell (Gov Affairs)
Frank Yeary served as Interim Executive Chair Dec 2024 - March 2025
compensation_highlights: New CEO Lip-Bu Tan: ~$69M package contingent on targets, including $25M share purchase requirement. CFO compensation increased significantly with Johnston Holthaus promotion. Interim Chair Yeary received $700K RSU award for transition service.
governance_notes: Independent Board Chair Frank Yeary. Board operates through Audit Committee and Governance Committee. 2014 commitment to actively seek women and minority Board candidates. 2025 Annual Meeting scheduled May 6, 2025.
